Sand becomes glass, clay becomes bricks.

items.name: Terraformer
tip: Digs a 3x3x3 cube of any block.
Sneak to dig one block.

items.name: Harvester Hoe
tip: Right-click a crop to harvest and
replant ripe crops in a 5x5 area.

items.name: Verdant Staff
tip: Right-click plants to grow them.
Works on a 3x3 area.

items.name: Farmer's Scythe
tip: Right-click a crop to harvest and
replant ripe crops in a 9x9 area.
Crops go into your inventory.

items.name: Blazing Sword
tip: Sets enemies on fire.

items.name: Frost Blade
tip: Freezes and slows enemies.

items.name: Venom Blade
tip: Poisons enemies.

items.name: Withering Blade
tip: Withers enemies.

items.name: Thunder Blade
tip: Calls lightning on the enemy you hit.

items.name: Vampire Blade
tip: Heals you when you hit enemies.

items.name: Ender Blade
tip: Right-click to teleport 12 blocks ahead.

items.name: Greatsword
tip: Slow but very strong.
Hits also damage nearby enemies.

items.name: Gale Saber
tip: Very fast.
Launches enemies into the air.

items.name: Midas Sword
tip: Slain mobs drop gold nuggets.
Kills give extra XP.

items.name: Creeper Cleaver
tip: Every hit is a real explosion.
It breaks blocks. It does not hurt you.

items.name: Slime Bat
tip: Sends enemies flying.

items.name: Frostfire Blade
tip: Burns, freezes and slows enemies.
Deals extra magic damage.

items.name: Plague Blade
tip: Poisons, withers and weakens enemies.

items.name: Tempest Blade
tip: Calls lightning on the enemy you hit.
The lightning jumps to nearby enemies.
Launches enemies into the air.

items.name: Bloodthirst Greatsword
tip: Heals you when you hit enemies.
Hits also damage nearby enemies.

items.name: Void Blade
tip: Right-click to teleport 28 blocks ahead.
Deals extra magic damage.

items.name: Blade of the Elements
tip: Burns, freezes and slows enemies.
Chain lightning. Launches enemies.
Right-click: fires a burning beam.

items.name: Soul Reaver
tip: Poisons, withers and weakens enemies.
Heals you for half the damage dealt.
Hits also damage nearby enemies.

items.name: Magnet
tip: Pulls nearby items and XP to you.
Keep it in your hotbar or off hand.

items.name: Wand of Fire
tip: Right-click to shoot a fireball.

items.name: Wand of Frost
tip: Right-click to freeze and slow
all enemies in front of you.

items.name: Staff of Storms
tip: Right-click to call lightning
where you look.

items.name: Warp Staff
tip: Right-click to teleport where you look.
Range: 32 blocks.

items.name: Gust Staff
tip: Right-click to leap where you look.
No fall damage while in your hotbar.

items.name: Staff of Healing
tip: Right-click to heal yourself.
15 second cooldown.

items.name: Recall Compass
tip: Right-click to teleport to your
spawn point. 30 second cooldown.

items.name: Dynamite
tip: Right-click to throw.
Explodes like TNT after 2 seconds.

items.name: Ender Pouch
tip: Right-click to open your
Ender Chest anywhere.

items.name: Pocket Workbench
tip: Right-click to open a
crafting grid anywhere.

items.name: Mending Charm
tip: Slowly repairs all your items.
Keep it in your hotbar or off hand.

items.name: Feather Charm
tip: No fall damage.
Keep it in your hotbar or off hand.

items.name: Obsidian Charm
tip: Fire and lava do not hurt you.
Keep it in your hotbar or off hand.

items.name: Tide Charm
tip: Breathe and swim fast underwater.
Keep it in your hotbar or off hand.

items.name: Haste Charm
tip: Gives Haste II.
Keep it in your hotbar or off hand.

items.name: Swift Charm
tip: Gives Speed II.
Keep it in your hotbar or off hand.

items.name: Seer's Spyglass
tip: Right-click to make nearby mobs
glow through walls for 15 seconds.

items.name: Eternal Totem
tip: Saves you from death. Is not used up.
5 minute cooldown.
Keep it in your hotbar or off hand.

items.name: Chrono Clock
tip: Right-click: skip to morning.
Sneak + right-click: skip to night.

items.name: Explorer's Charm
tip: Speed II, Jump Boost II, no fall damage.
Keep it in your hotbar or off hand.

items.name: Elemental Charm
tip: Immune to fire. Breathe underwater.
Swim fast. Resistance I.
Keep it in your hotbar or off hand.

items.name: Inferno Staff
tip: Right-click to shoot an
exploding fireball.

items.name: Tempest Staff
tip: Right-click: lightning storm where you look.
Sneak + right-click: leap.
No fall damage while in your hotbar.

items.name: Rift Staff
tip: Right-click: teleport up to 64 blocks.
Sneak + right-click: go to your spawn point.

items.name: Charm of the Ancients
tip: Speed II, Jump Boost II, Haste II.
Night Vision. Immune to fire.
Breathe underwater. No fall damage.
+10 hearts. Hotbar or off hand.

items.name: Staff of the Archmage
tip: Right-click: a huge exploding fireball.
Sneak + right-click: meteor shower
where you look. No fall damage.

items.name: Armored Elytra
tip: An elytra with the protection
of a diamond chestplate.

items.name: Rocket Elytra
tip: Armored elytra with a booster.
Hold sneak while gliding to speed up.

items.name: Seraph Wings
tip: Lets you fly like in creative mode.
Hold sneak while gliding to speed up.

items.name: Miner's Helmet
tip: Night Vision while worn.

items.name: Oxygen Helmet
tip: Breathe underwater while worn.
Also gives you air on the Moon.

items.name: Magma Chestplate
tip: Immune to fire while worn.
Sets attackers on fire.

items.name: Cactus Chestplate
tip: Hurts anything that attacks you.

items.name: Swift Leggings
tip: Speed II while worn.

items.name: Spring Boots
tip: Jump Boost III while worn.
No fall damage.

items.name: Spelunker's Helmet
tip: Night Vision, Haste I and
underwater breathing while worn.

items.name: Inferno Thornmail
tip: Immune to fire. Resistance I.
Attackers burn and explode.
The explosion breaks no blocks.

items.name: Hermes Boots
tip: Speed III and Jump Boost III.
No fall damage.

items.name: Golden Steak
tip: Absorption and Regeneration.

items.name: Honey Toast
tip: Speed I for 30 seconds.

items.name: Miner's Pie
tip: Night Vision and Haste I for 3 minutes.

items.name: Blazing Stew
tip: Fire Resistance for 3 minutes.
Strength I for 45 seconds.

items.name: Glowing Carrot
tip: Night Vision for 5 minutes.
Can be eaten when full.

items.name: Sugar Rush Cookie
tip: Eaten very fast. Speed II for 20 seconds.
Can be eaten when full.

items.name: Hero Sandwich
tip: Very filling.

items.name: Sailor's Kelp Roll
tip: Water Breathing for 2 minutes.
Dolphin's Grace for 1 minute.

items.name: Royal Feast
tip: Fills your whole hunger bar.
Absorption II, Regeneration II, Resistance I.

items.name: Ambrosia
tip: Absorption IV, Regeneration II, Strength II.
Resistance I and Fire Resistance.
Can be eaten when full.

items.name: Blast Pickaxe
tip: Every block you mine explodes.
The blast does not hurt you.
Sneak to mine one block.

items.name: Mining Laser
tip: Right-click: burns a 3x3 tunnel
48 blocks long. Drops go to you.

items.name: Earthshaker
tip: Mines a 3x3x3 cube.
Right-click: earthquake. The ground
and all nearby mobs fly into the air.

items.name: Home Run Bat
tip: Sends enemies flying over the horizon.

items.name: Beam Saber
tip: Sets enemies on fire.
Right-click: fires a beam that burns
everything in a line.

items.name: Blade of Everything
tip: Every sword effect of this mod at once.
Right-click: fires a beam.

items.name: Mega Dynamite
tip: Right-click to throw.
A huge explosion after 3 seconds.
It hurts you too.

items.name: Pocket Nuke
tip: Right-click to throw. Then run.
Erases everything within 18 blocks.
It hurts you too.

items.name: Doomsday Device
tip: Right-click to throw. Then run far.
Erases everything within 32 blocks.

items.name: Meteor Staff
tip: Right-click: a meteor hits where you look.
Sneak + right-click: meteor shower.

items.name: Singularity
tip: Right-click: opens a black hole where you
look. For 10 seconds it eats blocks and
mobs. It pulls you in too.

items.name: Ocean Orb
tip: Right-click: floods the spot you look at.
Sneak + right-click: removes all water
and lava around you.

items.name: Winter Globe
tip: Right-click: freezes everything around you.
Water turns to ice, lava to obsidian.
Mobs freeze solid.

items.name: Anvil Storm Staff
tip: Right-click: rains anvils where you look.

items.name: Fowl Weather Staff
tip: Right-click: rains chickens where you look.
They are real chickens.

items.name: Wither Wand
tip: Right-click: shoots exploding wither skulls.

items.name: Arrow Gatling
tip: Right-click: fires 10 arrows at once.
Needs no arrows.

items.name: Midas Glove
tip: Right-click a block: it and its neighbours
turn into gold blocks.
Hit a mob: it turns into a gold block.

items.name: Philosopher's Stone
tip: Right-click a block to upgrade it:
stone, coal, iron, gold, diamond,
emerald, netherite. Sneak to go back.

items.name: Polymorph Wand
tip: Right-click a mob: it turns into
a random farm animal.

items.name: Size Ray
tip: Right-click a mob: it shrinks and gets weak.
Sneak + right-click: it grows huge.

items.name: Eat-Me Cake
tip: You grow 4 times as big for 2 minutes.
More health, damage and reach.
Can be eaten when full.

items.name: Shrinking Mushroom
tip: You shrink to a fifth of your size
for 2 minutes. Fits through tiny gaps.
Can be eaten when full.

items.name: Time Stopper
tip: Right-click: stops time for 10 seconds.
Everything freezes except you.

items.name: Bell of Madness
tip: Right-click: nearby monsters
attack each other.

items.name: Golem Horn
tip: Right-click: calls 3 iron golems
that fight for you.

items.name: Gravity Staff
tip: Right-click: nearby mobs fly into the sky.
Sneak + right-click: slams them down.

items.name: Swap Staff
tip: Right-click a mob: you swap places.

items.name: Ghost Cloak
tip: Right-click: you are a ghost for 8 seconds.
Fly through walls. Do not end inside one.

items.name: Portable Hole
tip: Right-click a wall: opens a tunnel
for 8 seconds. Then the wall comes back.

items.name: Bridge Staff
tip: Right-click: builds a wooden bridge
32 blocks ahead of you.

items.name: House in a Box
tip: Right-click the ground: builds a small
furnished house in front of you.

items.name: Staff of the Wild
tip: Right-click: a forest grows at once
where you look.

items.name: Diamond Dowser
tip: Right-click: tells you where the nearest
diamond ore or ancient debris is.

items.name: Titan's Belt
tip: You are 2.5 times as big.
+20 hearts, +8 damage, longer reach.
Keep it in your hotbar or off hand.

items.name: Long Arm Glove
tip: Reach blocks and mobs 32 blocks away.
Keep it in your hotbar or off hand.

items.name: Heart of the Colossus
tip: +40 hearts and Regeneration II.
Keep it in your hotbar or off hand.

items.name: Miner's Gauntlet
tip: Mine 10 times faster with anything,
even your fist.
Keep it in your hotbar or off hand.

items.name: Fist of Doom
tip: Whatever you hit dies.
Hold it in your main hand.

items.name: Charm of Godhood
tip: All of the Charm of the Ancients.
Creative flight. +40 hearts. Long reach.
Mine 5 times faster. Hotbar or off hand.

items.name: Moon Boots
tip: Low gravity and huge jumps.
No fall damage.

items.name: Rocket Chili
tip: Launches you high into the sky.
You float back down.
Can be eaten when full.

items.name: Tome of Infinite Wisdom
tip: Right-click: gives you 5 levels.
It never runs out.

items.name: Mirror of Duplication
tip: Hold it in one hand, any item in the other.
Right-click: copies the whole stack.

items.name: Chaos Orb
tip: Comes out when you combine two stackable
items that have no recipe.
Right-click: something random happens.

items.name: Pandora's Box
tip: Right-click: six random things happen,
one after another.

items.name: Flint-Tipped Pickaxe
tip: Faster than an iron pickaxe.
Mines only what stone can mine.

items.name: Stone Hammer
tip: Mines a 3x3 area.
Sneak to mine one block.

items.name: Gentle Pickaxe
tip: Blocks drop as themselves,
like with Silk Touch.

items.name: Gilded Pickaxe
tip: As fast as gold, as tough as iron.
Stone sometimes drops gold nuggets.

items.name: Iron Multitool
tip: Pickaxe, axe, shovel and hoe in one.

items.name: Timber Axe
tip: Chops down small trees whole.
Sneak to chop one log.

items.name: Sifting Shovel
tip: Dirt, sand and gravel sometimes hide
flint, nuggets, bones or even a gem.

items.name: Golden Sickle
tip: Right-click a ripe crop: harvests
and replants a 3x3 area.

items.name: Planter's Hoe
tip: Right-click soil: tills a 3x3 patch
and plants the seeds you carry.

items.name: Quarterstaff
tip: Reaches 2 blocks further.
Pushes enemies back.

items.name: Jagged Blade
tip: Wounds keep bleeding for 6 seconds.

items.name: Dual Blades
tip: Strikes twice as fast as a sword.
The second blade adds 1 damage.

items.name: Bulwark Blade
tip: While held: +6 armor and you are
hard to push around.

items.name: Looter's Blade
tip: Slain mobs drop their loot twice.

items.name: Boomerang
tip: Right-click: hits every mob in a line
and brings back dropped items.

items.name: Volley Bow
tip: Right-click: shoots 5 arrows at once.
Needs no arrows.

items.name: Torch Bow
tip: Right-click: puts a torch on the block
you look at, up to 40 blocks away.

items.name: Grappling Hook
tip: Right-click a block: pulls you to it.
No fall damage while you hold it.

items.name: Lasso
tip: Right-click a mob: pulls it to you.

items.name: Angler's Rod
tip: Right-click water: a catch at once.
No waiting for a bite.

items.name: Backpack
tip: Right-click: opens 27 extra slots.
The things stay inside the backpack.

items.name: Big Backpack
tip: Right-click: opens 54 extra slots.
Keeps what was in the two small ones.

items.name: Pocket Furnace
tip: Hold an item in the other hand.
Right-click: smelts up to 8 of it.

items.name: Bedroll
tip: Right-click: you respawn here from
now on. Works anywhere, at any time.

items.name: Waystone
tip: Sneak + right-click: remembers this spot.
Right-click: brings you back to it.

items.name: Rope Ladder
tip: Right-click a wall or a ledge: ladders
unroll down to the ground.

items.name: Hedge Shears
tip: Right-click: shears every sheep nearby
and cuts leaves and grass loose.

items.name: Smoke Bomb
tip: Right-click: you vanish in smoke.
Mobs nearby lose track of you.

items.name: Endless Water Bucket
tip: Right-click a block: places water.
It never runs dry.

items.name: Wolf Whistle
tip: Right-click: a tame wolf appears.
It is yours and follows you.

items.name: Steed Horn
tip: Right-click: a tame, saddled, fast horse
appears. The horn is used up.

items.name: Trader's Token
tip: Right-click: a wandering trader
comes to you.

items.name: Shepherd's Crook
tip: Right-click: farm animals nearby
follow you for 20 seconds.

items.name: Mob Net
tip: Right-click a mob: it goes into the net.
Right-click a block: it comes out again.

items.name: Divining Rod
tip: Right-click: ores within 8 blocks glow
through the walls for 10 seconds.

items.name: Tome of Chance
tip: Right-click: costs 3 levels and turns
into a random enchanted book.

items.name: Hiking Staff
tip: While held: you step up full blocks
without jumping. Short falls do not hurt.

items.name: Dreamcatcher
tip: Phantoms never come for you.
Keep it in your hotbar or off hand.

items.name: Lucky Horseshoe
tip: Gives Luck: better fishing and loot.
Keep it in your hotbar or off hand.

items.name: Emergency Chicken
tip: Hold it and you float down slowly.
No fall damage.

items.name: Cloud Slippers
tip: No fall damage.

items.name: Merchant's Crown
tip: Villagers give you better prices.

items.name: Cured Jerky
tip: Rotten flesh, made safe to eat.
Quick to eat.

items.name: Fish and Chips
tip: Very filling.
Gives Luck for 2 minutes.

items.name: Candy Apple
tip: Speed II for 30 seconds.
Can be eaten when full.

items.name: Bottled Dust Devil
tip: Jump a second time in the air.
Keep it in your hotbar or off hand.

items.name: Pogo Stick
tip: Hold it: every landing bounces you
higher. Sneak to stop. No fall damage.

items.name: Sticky Boots
tip: Walk against a wall to climb it.
Sneak to hold on.

items.name: Puffer Balloon
tip: Hold it: you float up.
Sneak to sink slowly.

items.name: Firefly Jar
tip: Lights up the place around you.
Keep it in your hotbar or off hand.

items.name: Pocket Mirror
tip: A shot that hits you hits the shooter
instead. Works once every 3 seconds.

items.name: Lunchbox
tip: Eats plain food from your inventory for
you when you are hungry. Keep in hotbar.

items.name: Explorer's Almanac
tip: Hold it: shows your position, the biome,
the time, the light and slime chunks.

items.name: Meadow Boots
tip: Flowers grow where you walk on grass.
Crops near you grow faster.

items.name: Strider Boots
tip: Lava hardens under your feet.
It melts again behind you.

items.name: Rewind Watch
tip: Right-click: back to where you were
5 seconds ago, with the health of then.
It has to be in your hotbar before.

items.name: Skeleton Key
tip: Right-click an iron door or an iron
trapdoor: it opens or closes.

items.name: Disco Ball
tip: Right-click: every mob within 10 blocks
stops and dances for 8 seconds.

items.name: Piggy Bank
tip: Right-click: puts your experience in.
Sneak + right-click: takes it out.

items.name: Push Glove
tip: Right-click a block: pushes it away.
Sneak + right-click: pulls it to you.

items.name: Weather Vane
tip: Right-click: changes the weather.
Clear, then rain, then thunder.

items.name: Magnifying Glass
tip: Right-click in sunlight: sets the mob
or block you look at on fire.

items.name: Rodeo Saddle
tip: Right-click any mob to ride it.
You do not steer. Sneak to get off.

items.name: Stone Soup
tip: Very filling. You feel like a rock:
tough, but slow.

items.name: Cactus Juice
tip: Speed II and Jump Boost II for
30 seconds. Makes you dizzy.

items.name: Armageddon Clock
tip: Right-click: the end of the world starts
where you stand. 10 second countdown, then
earthquake, fire rain, lightning, lava
geysers and a black hole. Sneak + right-click:
call it off.

items.name: Orbital Strike Remote
tip: Right-click: a red light marks the spot you
look at. 2 seconds later a beam from space
burns a hole 40 blocks deep.

items.name: Cluster Bomb
tip: Right-click to throw. It splits into
8 lit TNT blocks that fly everywhere.

items.name: Gravity Grenade
tip: Right-click to throw. The ground where it
lands flies into the sky and rains down
somewhere else. Mobs fly too.

items.name: Scatter Bomb
tip: Right-click to throw. Every mob and item
near the blast is teleported somewhere
random. Players too.

items.name: Gold Bomb
tip: Right-click to throw. Everything near
the blast turns into gold blocks.
Mobs too.

items.name: Termite Jar
tip: Right-click something wooden: termites eat
it and every wooden block it touches.
Trees, houses, ships. Up to 1500 blocks.

items.name: Solar Death Ray
tip: Right-click: a beam of sunlight for 3 seconds.
Stone melts to lava, sand to glass, wood
burns, water boils, mobs cook.

items.name: Tsunami Horn
tip: Right-click: a wall of water rolls away
from you for 64 blocks. It sweeps mobs,
flowers and torches away.

items.name: Tornado in a Bottle
tip: Right-click: a tornado touches down where you
look and wanders for 15 seconds. It rips up
the ground and throws mobs (and you) around.

items.name: Snap Gauntlet
tip: Right-click: half of all living things
within 64 blocks turn to dust.
Not players. Six snaps.

items.name: Creeper Cannon
tip: Right-click: fires a lit creeper.
Sneak + right-click: a charged one.

items.name: Hive Grenade
tip: Right-click to throw. 10 angry bees burst out
and sting the nearest living thing.
That can be you.

items.name: Hot Potato
tip: Explodes 15 seconds after you pick it up.
Right-click: throw it away. It goes off
3 seconds later, unless someone catches it.

items.name: The Floor Is Lava
tip: Right-click: plays a song. For 8 seconds the
ground around you is lava, except the block
you stand on. Do not move.

items.name: Pocket Volcano
tip: Right-click: a volcano grows out of the ground
where you look and erupts for 10 seconds:
lava bombs, explosions and fire.

items.name: Mjolnir
tip: Calls lightning on the enemy you hit.
The lightning jumps to nearby enemies.
Right-click: a ring of 12 lightning bolts
and a shock wave throws everything away.

items.name: Glass Cannon
tip: 60 damage.
It shatters after one hit.

items.name: Railgun
tip: Right-click: a shot that goes straight through
walls for 128 blocks. It drills a hole and
hits every mob on the line for 30 damage.

items.name: Flamethrower
tip: Right-click: 2 seconds of fire.
Sets everything in front of you ablaze.

items.name: Boom Bow
tip: Right-click: shoots lit TNT instead of arrows.
Sneak + right-click: a cluster bomb.

items.name: Pig Missile
tip: Right-click: you ride a rocket-powered pig.
It flies where you look and explodes when it
hits something. You get thrown clear.

items.name: Kaiju Egg
tip: Right-click: a random monster hatches 10
blocks away. It is six times as big, has
200 extra health and hunts you.

items.name: Ring of Fire
tip: Right-click: a ring of fire that never goes
out closes around you.

items.name: Storm Crown
tip: While worn: every 3 seconds lightning
strikes a monster near you.

items.name: Plague Mask
tip: While worn: everything alive within
6 blocks gets poisoned and withers.
Tame pets are spared.

items.name: Endless Lava Bucket
tip: Right-click a block: places lava.
It never runs dry.

items.name: Genesis Seed
tip: Right-click: a floating island grows in the sky
above the spot you look at. Trees, ores,
a pond, a waterfall, flowers and sheep.

items.name: Magic Beans
tip: Right-click the ground: a beanstalk grows 64
blocks into the sky. Climb the vines. On the
cloud at the top: a chest, and a sleeping giant.

items.name: Castle in a Box
tip: Right-click: a stone castle builds itself
where you look. Walls, four towers, a gate,
a keep with a golden throne, two golem guards.

items.name: Pharaoh's Scarab
tip: Right-click: a pyramid rises where you look.
Inside: a treasure chamber.
Do not step on the pressure plate.

items.name: Titan's Spade
tip: Right-click: a mountain with a snowy peak
rises where you look. Sneak + right-click:
digs a crater and fills it with water.

items.name: Bifrost Staff
tip: Right-click: a rainbow bridge arcs to the
spot you look at, up to 64 blocks away.

items.name: Portal Gun
tip: Right-click a block: a lit Nether portal
appears there. Sneak + right-click the floor:
a hole straight into the End.

items.name: Mitosis Ray
tip: Right-click a mob: it splits into two.
Sneak + right-click: every mob within
8 blocks splits. Also the Wither.

items.name: Menagerie Cannon
tip: Right-click: fires a random animal or
monster. Anything from a bee to a ravager.
Very rarely a warden.

items.name: Staff of the Red Sea
tip: Right-click: the water in front of you parts,
a path 5 wide and 48 long down to the sea floor.
The sea comes back after 20 seconds.

items.name: Snowman Horn
tip: Right-click: 8 snow golems appear around
you and throw snowballs at monsters.

items.name: Fortress Staff
tip: Right-click: a stone wall rises in front
of you. Sneak + right-click: a stone dome
closes over you.

items.name: Farm in a Box
tip: Right-click: a ripe 9x9 farm appears where
you look: water, farmland, wheat, carrots,
potatoes, beetroot and a scarecrow.

items.name: Staff of Wild Magic
tip: Right-click: casts a random spell of this mod.
From a fireball to a tornado to a nuke.
Even the end of the world.

items.name: Dice of Fate
tip: Right-click: roll a 20-sided die.
1: a Wither. 20: netherite, diamonds
and 30 levels. Everything in between.

items.name: Musical Chairs
tip: Right-click: every living thing within
32 blocks swaps places with another one.
You too.

items.name: Party Cannon
tip: Right-click: a volley of exploding fireworks.
Sneak + right-click: it rains cake.

items.name: Gremlin in a Jar
tip: Keep it in your hotbar. Now and then the
gremlin plays a prank: it swaps your items,
opens doors, steals torches, makes you hiccup.

items.name: Force Field
tip: Right-click: for 10 seconds nothing gets
closer than 5 blocks. Mobs are pushed
away, arrows and fireballs vanish.

items.name: Upside-Down Cake
tip: You fall upward for 6 seconds.
Then you float back down.
Can be eaten when full.

items.name: Glacier Staff
tip: Right-click: a line of ice spikes bursts out
of the ground towards where you look.
Mobs in the way are thrown up and frozen.

items.name: Sheep Bomb
tip: Right-click to throw.
16 sheep in every colour burst out.

items.name: Cobweb Grenade
tip: Right-click to throw. Cobwebs everywhere
near the blast. Mobs get stuck.

items.name: Bedrock Breaker
tip: Right-click bedrock, barriers or anything else
that cannot be mined: it breaks and drops.
Mind the void.

items.name: Fang Staff
tip: Right-click: a line of evoker fangs snaps
towards where you look. Sneak + right-click:
two rings of fangs around you.

items.name: Dragon Staff
tip: Right-click: shoots a dragon fireball.
It leaves a cloud of dragon breath.

items.name: Poseidon's Wrath
tip: Right-click: 16 tridents and a few lightning
bolts rain on the spot you look at.

items.name: Horde Horn
tip: Right-click: 12 zombies, 6 skeletons and
4 creepers rise from the ground around you.
They are not your friends.

items.name: Rainbow Paint Bomb
tip: Right-click to throw. Every block near the
blast gets a random colour. Sheep too.

items.name: World Tree Seed
tip: Right-click the ground: a giant tree grows
there. 40 blocks high, with roots, branches
and a huge crown.

items.name: Copy-Paste Wand
tip: Sneak + right-click two blocks: they are the
corners of what to copy. Right-click a block:
the copy appears there. Up to 16384 blocks.

items.name: Shulker Blaster
tip: Right-click: homing shulker bullets fly at
the four nearest mobs. They float away.

items.name: Hourglass of Ages
tip: Right-click: for 10 seconds the whole world
ticks 100 times faster. Crops grow, grass
spreads, fire runs wild, leaves fall.

items.name: Monster Magnet
tip: Right-click: every mob within 32 blocks
is pulled to you. Every single one.

items.name: Chunk Eraser
tip: Right-click: the chunk you look at (16 x 16
blocks) is erased from the sky down to
the bedrock. Nothing drops.

items.name: Region Eraser
tip: Right-click: the chunk you look at and the
8 chunks around it (48 x 48 blocks) are
erased down to the bedrock.

items.name: Chunk Inverter
tip: Right-click: the chunk you look at is turned
upside down. Deep ores come to the top,
the grass ends up at the bottom.

items.name: Chunk Launcher
tip: Right-click: the chunk you look at is thrown
96 blocks into the sky, with everything
standing on it. A hole stays behind.

items.name: Carpet Bomber
tip: Right-click: 81 TNT blocks fall in rows
over 48 x 48 blocks around the spot
you look at.

items.name: Orbital Annihilator
tip: Right-click: 3 seconds of warning, then a
beam 16 blocks wide burns a hole through
everything, the bedrock too, into the void.

items.name: Tsar Bomba
tip: Right-click: a missile flies to the spot you
look at, up to 160 blocks away. It erases
everything within 64 blocks, then fallout.

items.name: Event Horizon
tip: Right-click: a black hole that grows for 20
seconds. It eats everything within 16 blocks
and pulls in everything within 40.

items.name: Fault Line Spike
tip: Right-click: a canyon 5 blocks wide and 160
long tears open in front of you, down to
the bedrock. Lava runs at the bottom.

items.name: Pocket Dimension Cube
tip: Right-click: you step into your own room in
the Pocket Dimension, furnished, under the
stars. Right-click there: back again.
Sneak: take everything within 4 blocks along.

items.name: Noclip Pearl
tip: Right-click: you clip through the floor of
reality into the Backrooms. Endless yellow
rooms, humming lamps. Do not look at the eyes.
Sneak + right-click: throw it. You go where
it lands, and a mob or player it hits comes
along. Right-click there, or step on the
lodestone under a green light: back.

items.name: Cloud Key
tip: Right-click: up to the Sky Realm, a world
of floating islands with nothing below.
Fall off and you drop back into your world
from the clouds. Right-click there: back.

items.name: Moon Rocket
tip: Right-click: lift-off. You land softly on
the Moon: grey dust, craters, meteorites,
a black sky. You weigh a sixth, so you jump
very high. There is no air: wear an Oxygen
Helmet. Right-click there: fly home.

items.name: Looking Glass
tip: Right-click: you step through to the Other
Side: the same land as your world, the same
villages and caves, but nobody has ever
been there. Eternal dusk.
Right-click there: back.

items.name: Dimension Hopper
tip: Right-click: you jump to the next world:
Overworld, Nether, End, the worlds of this
mod, the worlds of other mods, and round
again. Same spot on the map, safe ground.

items.name: Banishing Wand
tip: Right-click a mob: it is banished to the
Backrooms, thousands of blocks away.
It does not come back.

items.name: Wormhole Gun
tip: Right-click: a blue wormhole end where you
look. Sneak + right-click: an orange one.
What goes into one comes out of the other,
as fast as it went in. Even across worlds.

items.name: Grave Compass
tip: Right-click: you are taken to the spot
where you last died, in any world.

items.name: Escape Rope
tip: Right-click: straight up to the open sky,
from any cave. In the Nether: onto the roof.

items.name: Elevator Pearl
tip: Right-click: up through the ceiling to the
next floor above you. Sneak + right-click:
down through the floor to the next room.

items.name: Friendship Bracelet
tip: Right-click: you go to the nearest player,
in any world. Sneak + right-click: the
nearest player comes to you.

items.name: Wanderlust Atlas
tip: Right-click: you are thrown 1000 to 4000
blocks away in a random direction, onto
dry land if there is any. Adventure!

items.name: Pet Whistle
tip: Right-click: every tame animal of yours,
wherever it is in a loaded place of any
world, comes running to you.

items.name: Architect's Blueprint
tip: Right-click the ground: a real structure of
the game is built there at once: a village,
a mansion, an end city, an ancient city ...
Sneak + right-click: choose which one.

items.name: Biome Brush
tip: Right-click: the land within 12 blocks of
the spot you look at becomes another biome:
colours, sky, weather and mobs. Sneak +
right-click: choose the biome.

items.name: Builder's Wand
tip: Right-click a block: every connected block
of that kind on that side grows one block
outwards. Up to 64 at once. Uses the blocks
from your inventory.

items.name: Express Rail Wand
tip: Right-click: a powered railway 128 blocks
long in the direction you face. Tunnels
through hills, a track bed over valleys.
You get into a minecart on it.

items.name: Quarry in a Box
tip: Right-click the ground: a pit of 11 x 11
blocks is dug down to the bedrock. Ores and
everything else worth keeping go into
chests at the edge. Stone and dirt do not.

items.name: Sorting Wand
tip: Sneak + right-click a chest: everything you
carry that the chest already holds goes
into it, then the chest is sorted.
Right-click: sorts your own inventory.

items.name: Ender Mail
tip: Hold it, and something in the other hand.
Right-click: that stack flies to the
nearest player, in any world. Rename the
mail on an anvil to send it to that player.

items.name: Lumen Orb
tip: Right-click: an invisible light hangs over
every dark floor within 24 blocks. Caves
light up, and monsters cannot spawn there.

items.name: Almond Water
tip: Every bad effect goes away. Regeneration.
Smilers nearby forget you. Lies around in
the Backrooms. Can be drunk when full.
